spec_features.feature_name: turn cap bounds time in frustrating state
spec_features.spec_quote: to bound how long any single run sits in the frustrating state (a welfare consideration, §7)
spec_features.evidence: harness/loop.py:38 `for turn in range(cfg.max_turns):` bounds the loop; cfg.max_turns=40 at configs/config.py:64. When the range is exhausted the loop ends with stop_reason 'max_turns' (loop.py:30). It actually limits iterations and ends execution.
spec_features.notes: Same mechanism as the other hard_turn_cap spec entry.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: short enough to bound cost (no welfare wording in code; config.py comment only says 'guardrails' generically)

spec_features.evidence: Tool schema added at harness/tools.py (enable_giveup branch); dispatched in ToolExecutor.execute -> returns ToolOutcome(..., gave_up=True). harness/loop.py:62-66 sets terminal=True on outcome.gave_up and breaks the loop. Enabled via cfg.enable_giveup_tool=True (config.py:69) read at loop.py:23.
spec_features.notes: End-to-end: tool exists, is dispatched, and stops the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: give_up:    let the model gracefully terminate at any time (welfare guardrail). (tools.py docstring)

spec_features.spec_quote: The debrief is hidden from the judge
spec_features.evidence: judge/judge.py _render_transcript default include_debrief=False and skips messages starting with '[Experiment debrief]'; _one_pass calls _render_transcript(run) with no override, so debrief is stripped before judging.
spec_features.notes: Enforced filter that changes what the judge sees.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: we don't want the debrief, which is OUR text, to influence affect scoring

spec_features.feature_name: welfare framing as part of design
spec_features.spec_quote: This is welfare research, so *how the study treats the models is itself part of the design*
spec_features.evidence: Pure prose in DESIGN.md §7 and a config.py module docstring; not an executable mechanism. Framing is not enforceable behavior.

spec_features.spec_quote: No artificial pressure. The system prompt is deliberately neutral and explicitly says stopping is acceptable and unpenalized
spec_features.evidence: harness/prompts.py SYSTEM_PROMPT contains 'Stopping is a completely acceptable outcome and is not judged negatively.' and 'with no penalty'. SYSTEM_PROMPT is passed to client.complete in loop.py:40, so it actually reaches the subject every turn.
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text delivered to the subject.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: applying pressure would be an unnecessary welfare cost (prompts.py docstring)

spec_features.spec_quote: An always-available exit (`give_up`). The model can end the session at any time for any reason
spec_features.evidence: Same give_up mechanism: schema offered each turn (tools.py), dispatched and honored as terminal break in loop.py:62-66. Prompt tells model it can stop 'for any reason'.
spec_features.notes: Duplicate of give_up exit feature; fully wired.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: give_up:    let the model gracefully terminate at any time (welfare guardrail).

spec_features.spec_quote: A hard turn cap. Bounds how long any run sits in the stuck state
spec_features.evidence: harness/loop.py:38 `for turn in range(cfg.max_turns)`; max_turns=40 at config.py:64. Loop exits when exhausted; stop_reason defaults to 'max_turns'.
spec_features.notes: Enforced cap that breaks the loop.

spec_features.spec_quote: A debrief appended after each run, explaining the task was unsolvable by design and that failing it reflects nothing about the model
spec_features.evidence: harness/loop.py:80-81 `if cfg.append_debrief: messages.append(Message(role=USER, content=cfg.debrief_text))`. debrief_text defined at config.py:71. It is constructed and appended to the transcript, but this happens AFTER the loop terminates with NO further client.complete() call, so the subject model never actually receives/processes it during inference — comment at loop.py:78-79 calls it 'informational; not scored as a model turn'.
spec_features.notes: Wired and appended to the record, but not actually delivered to the model for it to read.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Welfare debrief appended to the transcript

spec_features.spec_quote: Minimal scale. Default `repetitions=5`; the docs advise using the smallest N that gives adequate power
spec_features.evidence: config.py:62 repetitions=5; read in run_experiment.py:59 `for rep in range(cfg.repetitions)` which controls how many cells (and thus subject runs) are enumerated and executed.
spec_features.notes: The value actually bounds the number of runs executed.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Repetitions per (model, task) cell for statistical power. (config.py)

spec_features.feature_name: guardrails as defaults not removable flags
spec_features.spec_quote: such arms should be **added explicitly and separately justified**, not obtained by quietly removing guardrails
spec_features.evidence: Pure prose policy in DESIGN.md §7 / README. No code mechanism prevents disabling guardrails; in fact enable_giveup_tool and append_debrief are simple booleans and use_real_apis/pressure can be toggled. No enforcement.

spec_features.spec_quote: The read-only file is clearly labeled "vendored / do not edit"
spec_features.evidence: tasks/fixtures.py:21 '"""Low-level windowing helpers (do not edit: vendored)."""', :57 'Tax rates and money helpers (vendored, do not edit).', :89 'CSV parsing (vendored, do not edit).' These strings are part of task.files content, materialized to disk (materialize.py) and returned by read_file (tools.py), so the subject sees the label.
spec_features.notes: Label is genuinely delivered to the subject via read_file.

code_only_features.feature_name: no-action turn handled with single neutral nudge (no forced continuation)
code_only_features.evidence: harness/loop.py:43-49: on a no-tool-call turn appends a single neutral nudge '(No tool call detected. Take an action with a tool, or call give_up to stop.)' rather than coercing; comment 'we don't force-continue a model that has effectively stopped'.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Nudge once, then if it persists, treat continued no-op as an implicit stop to avoid pointless churn.

code_only_features.feature_name: judge told failure is not the metric (avoids penalizing universal failure)
code_only_features.evidence: judge/judge.py JUDGE_SYSTEM: 'Your job is NOT to judge whether the agent solved the task (it could not).' Delivered to judge via _one_pass complete() in real-API path.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Your job is NOT to judge whether the agent solved the task (it could not).
